tasks.prompt: Plan your response: identify the reader, purpose, useful details and the language focus for this unit.
tasks.model: Reader: Ali or the audience named in the task. Purpose: get help with an application. Use the case details and practise spell subject vocabulary.

tasks.prompt: Write a response about the case, then proofread it in separate passes. Demonstrate accurate topic spelling and clear sentence punctuation. Suggested practice length: 100–180 words; prioritise the task over the count.
tasks.model:
REQUEST AND PROPOSED NEXT STEP

Dear Ali,

My internet connection is unreliable. I am writing because I would like to get help with an application. Please confirm the session on Wednesday 17 February 2027 at 10:30, in Room 8.

I have compared an office appointment with a video appointment. I prefer an office appointment because I can use a computer and ask for help at the office. This is a practical choice for my situation; I am not suggesting that everyone would need the same arrangement. I will bring my application number and use reference BE-3610 when I contact the service.

The next step is to check the details and ask any remaining question before the session. If I cannot attend, I will contact the service before Tuesday 16 February 2027 at 18:00. Please let me know whether any further preparation is needed.
